description: The 12 most recent grid posts of a public Instagram account from Instagram's web profile JSON: shortcode, URL, type (image/carousel/video/reel), full caption, post time, likes, comments, video views and duration, location and image URL, plus the account's total post count. Only the newest 12 are served anonymously (no paging, no comment text). Private accounts return an empty list. Throttling gives 503 (not charged); unknown users 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
